mapper.select: SELECT tenant_name FROM plat_tenant WHERE id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.sql: FROM iam_user_role ur JOIN iam_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id WHERE ur.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.deleted = 0 AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 'ENABLED'
mapper.select: SELECT r.role_name ORDER BY r.sort_no, r.id

SELECT r.role_name, COALESCE(r.data_scope_type, 'SELF') AS scope_code, COALESCE((SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MIN(ds.scope_name) END FROM iam_data_scope ds WHERE ds.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND ds.deleted = 0 AND ds.status = 'ENABLED' AND ds.scope_type = COALESCE(r.data_scope_type, 'SELF')), r.data_scope_type, 'SELF') AS scope_name, COALESCE(r.data_scope_type, 'SELF') AS scope_type ORDER BY r.sort_no, r.id
SELECT identity_type, identifier, verified, status, bound_at FROM iam_user_identity WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY id

SELECT e.employee_no, e.employee_name, e.dept_id, d.dept_name, d.dept_full_name, e.position_id, p.position_name, e.hire_date, e.employee_status FROM iam_employee e LEFT JOIN iam_department d ON d.id = e.dept_id AND d.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND d.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN iam_position p ON p.id = e.position_id AND p.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND p.deleted = 0 WHERE e.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND e.id = #{employeeId} AND e.deleted = 0
SELECT id, login_ip, success, fail_reason, occurred_at FROM audit_login_log WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 10
